div.div:
When arrival rate approaches processing capacity (rho = lambda / mu -> 1), queue length L_q = rho^2 / (1 - rho) diverges toward infinity.
Without strict buffer bounds, queue residence time explodes asymptotically, transforming temporary network hiccups into fatal cascading outages.
